audit_mode: Read-only completed stored acquisition; manually reconstructed feedback/frames/gates; no model/simulator calls
causal_scope: Conditional effects on known deterministic cases. Three arms do not identify origin effects at actual heading or a full factorial interaction; first-step components do not define downstream additive shares.
critical_findings: Hybrid heading selection improves both final sequence global lateral and heading errors versus actual/actual, but retains one local task failure.
Planned origin improves endpoint/lateral errors conditional on ideal heading while worsening final absolute heading errors on both sequences relative to hybrid.
Origin selection removes the second 4m local failure in hybrid but is insufficient to remove the first 8m heading/corridor conflict.
Both historical arms reproduce all physical fields and added diagnostics; task limits, skill status and labels remain unchanged.

recommended_exactly_one_next_factor.design: Predeclare one nonadaptive midpoint alpha=0.5 versus retained alpha=0 actual anchor and alpha=1 hybrid; do not search alpha on the observed 16m outcome or select a case-specific corridor-boundary value.
recommended_exactly_one_next_factor.factor: Correction-reference heading blend weight, with origin fixed at actual node start
recommended_exactly_one_next_factor.gate: Use the unchanged inherited conjunction before any separate training hypothesis. No envelopes, labels, rewards, or historical results are revised.
recommended_exactly_one_next_factor.implementation_status: NOT IMPLEMENTED; no next experiment or PPO started.
recommended_exactly_one_next_factor.limits: No guaranteed PASS or universal benefit. Retain every failure. Seen cases remain mechanism diagnostics; separately frozen probes are required for broader claims.
recommended_exactly_one_next_factor.prospective_construction: h_ref = h_actual_start + alpha * wrap(h_ideal_commanded - h_actual_start); fixed through each Walk. Keep origin, original gain/clamp/deadband, all measurement/task frames and lifecycle unchanged.
recommended_exactly_one_next_factor.purpose: Determine whether partial reference alignment yields global precision gains without forcing the diagnosed local corridor conflict; this is a deterministic construction experiment, not PPO.

remaining_geometric_conflict.inference: Removing planned-origin recentering reduces local drift but does not remove the ideal-heading/local-corridor conflict. Ideal-parallel-line tracking requires more local lateral motion than permitted at this first-node threshold.
remaining_geometric_conflict.scope: First 8m Walk at the unchanged local progress threshold; no whole-route impossibility claim
